Lawsuits Filed to Prevent Armed Agents at US Voting Sites

Civil rights groups have filed lawsuits arguing that the presence of armed federal agents at polling stations violates the Voting Rights Act. The legal actions specifically target suggestions that immigration enforcement agents could be deployed to monitor voting sites. These lawsuits aim to ensure that such deployments do not occur, citing concerns about voter intimidation and suppression.
